subject.title: UI/TUI: session-recap block leaks into visible user message rendering

question: Should maintainers wait for https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/252 to be rebased, or replace/adopt it with a narrow target-repository fix?
rationale: The bug boundary is clear, but the only open implementation candidate is a conflicting fork PR with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not silently open a competing fix without maintainer intent.

options.title: Replace or adopt the uneditable PR
options.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a replacement exists.

options.title: Ask the contributor to rebase
options.body: Keep this issue paired with the open fork PR and ask the contributor to rebase it with a maintainer-editable branch if possible.

options.title: Wait without action
options.body: Leave this issue and the fork PR open while accepting that the source-reproducible leak remains unresolved.

recommendation.title: Replace or adopt the uneditable PR
recommendation.body: Open or adopt a narrow target-repository PR, credit the source work, and close the fork PR only after a replacement exists.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest routing candidate because they merged the shared sanitizer boundary and authored the TUI leading-stripper path involved in this issue.
